notes.title: New Game Release: Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered Is Out!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311711/a50d8f1b46cccb596091cde02d70ba339786a852.jpg"]To all our series fans,

Thank you for your patience! We're excited to announce that Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered, the first title in the series, is officially released today, September 15th.

We've completely overhauled the graphics, re-recorded some of the voices, and made detailed revisions to the text and the "CYCLOPEDIA" feature. We've put a lot of work into this to give you a deeper and more immersive experience.

The game's full story is completely free to play. We invite you to dive into the world of the new Red Spider!
